name: Facet
text:
We should default to dark mode based on system preference, without a one-time theme picker. This approach removes the unnecessary decision fatigue for users and streamlines the first launch experience, aligning with the goal of speed and clarity. The trade-off is that a small number of users may need to manually switch to a different theme if their system preference doesn't match their desired EXCAVA theme. By doing so, we prioritize the majority of users' seamless experience over the flexibility of an initial theme choice.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A one-time picker isn’t just friction—it’s a hidden survey that locks users into a choice they’ll ignore forever. The real risk? Users who prefer light mode abandon the tool before seeing its value. Settle it by A/B testing: ship dark default with a persistent, dismissible toggle in settings—no picker, no delay, just data on what users actually do.
